mapper.select: SELECT id FROM pf.workspace_sandbox_slot WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT generation FROM pf.execution_dispatch WHERE task_id=#{lease.taskId} AND lease_owner=#{lease.ownerId} AND fencing_token=#{lease.fence} AND status='CLAIMED'

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_tool_file_admission a JOIN pf.tool_operation o ON o.id=a.operation_id LEFT JOIN pf.workspace_tool_job_binding b ON b.operation_id=a.operation_id AND b.file_operation_id IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN pf.file_operation f ON f.id=b.file_operation_id LEFT JOIN pf.file_runner_receipt r ON r.command_id=f.command_id AND r.space_id=f.space_id AND r.workspace_id=f.workspace_id WHERE a.space_id=#{lease.spaceId} AND a.task_id=#{lease.taskId} AND a.attempt_id=#{lease.attemptId} AND a.owner_id=#{lease.ownerId} AND a.fence=#{lease.fence} AND o.call_id=#{call} AND (b.file_operation_id IS NULL OR(r.stop_text::jsonb->>'commandId'=f.command_id::text AND r.stop_text::jsonb->>'execStopped'='true' AND r.stop_text::jsonb->>'callbacksStopped'='true' AND (r.stop_text::jsonb->>'neverStarted'='true' OR r.stop_text::jsonb->>'finishedAt' IS NOT NULL))))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.workspace_tool_job_binding(id,operation_id,space_id,task_id,workspace_id,file_operation_id) SELECT #{id},a.operation_id,a.space_id,a.task_id,a.workspace_id,u.operation_id FROM pf.workspace_tool_file_admission a JOIN pf.upload_session u ON u.id=a.upload_id WHERE a.operation_id=#{operation} AND a.failure_code IS NULL AND u.operation_id=#{fileOperation} ON CONFLICT(file_operation_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM pf.tool_operation WHERE space_id=#{space} AND task_id=#{task} AND call_id=#{call}
SELECT space_id FROM pf.space_storage WHERE space_id=#{space} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM pf.workspace WHERE space_id=#{space} AND id=#{workspace} AND actor_id=#{actor} AND state='READY' FOR UPDATE
SELECT task_id,space_id,workspace_id,actor_id,catalog_version,runtime_bundle_id FROM pf.task_tool_catalog WHERE space_id=#{space} AND task_id=#{task}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.task_tool_catalog(task_id,space_id,workspace_id,actor_id,catalog_version,runtime_bundle_id) SELECT b.task_id,b.space_id,b.workspace_id,b.actor_id,#{version},#{bundle} FROM pf.task_resource_binding b JOIN pf.workspace w ON w.space_id=b.space_id AND w.id=b.workspace_id AND w.actor_id=b.actor_id AND w.state='READY' WHERE b.space_id=#{space} AND b.task_id=#{task} AND b.actor_id=#{actor} AND b.workspace_id=#{workspace}
mapper.select: SELECT w.id workspace_id,w.space_id,w.actor_id,w.state,w.content_revision,w.quota_bytes,w.quota_inodes,w.project_id, e.version environment_version,e.state environment_state,e.image_id environment_image_id,e.policy_hash environment_policy_hash FROM pf.workspace w LEFT JOIN pf.workspace_environment e ON e.space_id=w.space_id AND e.workspace_id=w.id WHERE w.space_id=#{space} AND w.id=#{workspace} AND w.actor_id=#{actor}

SELECT operation_id,space_id,task_id,workspace_id,actor_id,tool_name,catalog_version,args_hash,content_revision,permission_version,policy_version, resource_hash,resource_json::text resource_json,review_json::text review_json,activation_request_id,expected_environment_version, expected_image_id,expected_policy_hash,created_at FROM pf.workspace_tool_intent WHERE space_id=#{space} AND task_id=#{task} AND operation_id=#{operation}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.plan_execution_acceptance(task_id,space_id,revision_id,answer_id) VALUES(#{task},#{space},#{revision},#{answer}) ON CONFLICT(task_id,revision_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM pf.task_plan p JOIN pf.plan_revision r ON r.plan_id=p.id AND r.revision=p.current_revision JOIN pf.plan_execution_acceptance a ON a.space_id=p.space_id AND a.task_id=p.task_id AND a.revision_id=r.id WHERE p.space_id=#{space} AND p.task_id=#{task} AND p.status='APPROVED'
